people.name: Ride-or-Die
people.read: You're the one who shows up first and tells the truth once you're there.
people.desc: You're in it with your people all the way, and you'll tell them the truth on the way in. Your loyalty is loud, honest and done your way.

life.name: The Planner
life.define: Plans ahead and sees it through.
life.read: You're the one with a plan, a backup plan and a date for both.
life.desc: You want big wins, and you like the steps to them mapped, checked and done properly. Your calendar is a love letter to future you.

archetype.opposite: Your opposite: Old Soul and The Spontaneous One. Know one?

axes.line: If there's a group plan, you started it. If there isn't, you're starting one.
Ask for your opinion and you'll get it, straight, no garnish.
How it's always been done has zero pull on you. You build your own.
Same order, same seat, same people. You found what works and you guard it.
Finish line spotted, brakes off. Coasting makes you itchy.
You read the terms and hold the line, even when it's awkward.

findings.line: You need proof you're getting somewhere. A finished list, a goal ticked, a door you pushed open.
How it's always been done is a suggestion to you. Your home, holidays and love life are custom builds.
Your boldest moves come after boring homework. Nobody sees the prep, so they call it luck.
Fair is how you keep people safe. You read the fine print and hold the line, awkward or not.
You say the hard thing early so nobody walks into a wall later. Blunt, yes. Also care.
You love in logistics. Shared calendars, the spare key, the group order: close means together.

tags.name: Believes in second chances
tags.line: You believe people can change, and you'll leave the door open while they try.
tags.heart: I believe people can change, because I have.

tags.name: Loves a win
tags.line: You want wins people can see, and you keep a quiet tally of every one.
tags.heart: Wanting to build something big isn't too much.

tags.name: Starts new traditions
tags.line: No script for how a home should run. You're writing your own.
tags.heart: No script is the gift I gave myself.

tags.name: First to volunteer
tags.line: Someone says they need hands and you're already putting on your shoes.
tags.heart: I love the world, and I'm practicing loving me too.

rooms.line: You want the win on the record: the credit, the next step, the bigger title.
You love your family and you run your own life. They've stopped arguing about it.
Bad haircut, bad ex, bad idea: you're the friend who says so, and they come back for it.
Love is love and a tab is a tab, and you'd rather owe nobody.

insight.line: Nobody has to decode you. People always know where they stand, and that's exactly why they relax around you.

stings: You'd go to war for your people. Letting them fight for you is the part you skip.
You hit the goal and start the next list before you celebrate.
You'd give a second chance to someone who hasn't finished asking.
